curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify curved lines in different situations

mission.title: identify curved lines in different situations

interactions.prompt: Look at the two lines. Tap the curvy line.

choices.label: A straight line
choices.accessibleDescription: a line that goes straight across

interactions.feedback: Yes! A curved line bends smoothly.
interactions.retryHint: Find the line that bends instead of going straight.

interactions.prompt: A rainbow makes a curvy line in the sky. Tap the rainbow.

choices.label: Rainbow
choices.accessibleDescription: a rainbow curved like an arch

interactions.feedback: Great looking! The rainbow has a curved line.
interactions.retryHint: Think of the line that bends like an arch.

interactions.prompt: Help the lion follow the curvy river. Trace the bending path.

targets.label: Curvy river path
targets.accessibleDescription: a path that bends gently from left to right

interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the curvy river path to choose it.
interactions.feedback: Well done! The river path is curved because it bends.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the path that turns and bends.

interactions.prompt: Which object has a curved line? Tap it.

choices.label: Banana
choices.accessibleDescription: a banana that bends in a curve

choices.label: Pencil
choices.accessibleDescription: a pencil with a straight side

choices.label: Book edge
choices.accessibleDescription: a straight edge of a book

interactions.feedback: Correct! The banana bends in a curved line.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the object that is not straight.

interactions.prompt: At the playground, which part is curved? Tap it.
interactions.feedback: You found it! The bending slide has a curved line.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the playground part that bends.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Trace the curved line around the bowl.

targets.label: Curved bowl edge
targets.accessibleDescription: the round edge of a bowl

targets.label: Straight table edge
targets.accessibleDescription: a straight edge of a table

interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the round edge of the bowl to choose it.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! The round edge of the bowl is a curved line.
interactions.retryHint: Pick the edge that bends around the bowl.
